defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20. App SDK documentation comes from the app-php-sdk and app-sdk-js repositories.

manifest.title: Shopware app manifest
manifest.description: Shopware apps: the app system versus plugins, the complete manifest.xml reference, registration and signatures, in-app purchases. Use when building a Shopware app or writing a manifest.xml.
manifest.intro: An app is declared entirely in manifest.xml and runs outside the shop. Start here before either SDK.

sdk.title: Shopware app SDKs
sdk.description: Shopware app SDKs: app-php-sdk and app-sdk-js — registration handling, request signing, webhooks, app scripts. Use when the request names the Shopware app-php-sdk or app-sdk-js.
sdk.intro: The SDKs handle registration, signature verification and webhook plumbing so you do not reimplement them.
